note: Despite the file name '2023-pillar-3-disclosures', this is The Nottingham's Pillar 3 INTERIM disclosure, key metrics at 30 June 2023 (cover, section 1.2 'as at 30th June 2023', KM1 p3 columns 30 June 2023 / 31 December 2022 / 30 June 2022). The queued 2023-12-31 is wrong: column a is 30 June 2023, and that is the period whose figures were already loaded (from the comparative column of the year-end 2023 report, pillar-3-disclosures-2023.pdf), hence the 'repeat'.
